hypotheses.name: Four-hop USDG–PONS–CASHCAT size-curve probe
hypotheses.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph contains the pools for WETH → USDG → PONS → CASHCAT → WETH, and this route/size/family cell is available. Hypothesis requiring fresh quotes: quoting every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH may show a size-dependent after-gas net that clears the entry rules at one of those sizes. The runner must select the greatest current after-gas net and must not scale quote outputs. The training cohort includes frames at blocks 97230723 and 97379861; neither validates this forward hypothesis.

hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both the same-size improvement and gas-safety conditions, or if valid quotes are unavailable. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure costs, and model-invoice costs prevent a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: WETH–USDG–PONS triangle quote-improvement probe
hypotheses.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph contains pools for WETH → USDG → PONS → WETH, and this route/size/family cell is available. Hypothesis requiring fresh quotes: at the exact 0.005 WETH size, amount out may improve by at least 100 bps against the previous consecutive source-valid quote while the current net edge covers safety gas. The first source-valid quote cannot signal. Cohort frames include blocks 97232624 and 97379861, but they do not establish a forward result for this cell.

limitations: No available cell in the supplied menu is shown using a token outside WETH, USDG, PONS, and CASHCAT, so an outside-token route could not be selected.
Training quotes and blocks are not forward validation; the runner must collect new same-block control/candidate observations after public source publication.

Quote opportunities are not fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns. The ten-observation screen may reject an unproductive idea but does not satisfy the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate.
